question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between Q and O. Only I sits to the right of P. Only one person sits between O and P. K sits at some place to the right of L but at some place to the left of J. How many people sit between J and L?
solution: Given, seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only I sits to the right of P. Only one person sits between O and P. Only two people sit between Q and O.
